files.projects.json: Top-level program index (12 items). Cross-references aircraft/uavs/engines/technologies via related_ids.
files.aircraft.json: Fixed-wing and rotary crewed platforms (8 items).
files.uavs.json: Unmanned platforms, HAL + closely linked DRDO/ADE programs (7 items).
files.engines.json: Propulsion programs, indigenous and key imported (7 items).
files.technologies.json: Cross-cutting technology themes not tied to a single platform (7 items).

schema.note: All item objects share this common field set for consistent dashboard table/card rendering.

fields.id: string, unique slug within its file
fields.status: string, current program status as of data_as_of
fields.engine: string, powerplant name or 'N/A' for engine-file entries
fields.related_ids: (projects.json only) object mapping other file names to arrays of related item ids

usage_note: Load this index first to discover available files and the shared schema, then fetch each file independently. projects.json.items[i].related_ids lets a dashboard build drill-down links from a top-level program card into its associated aircraft/uav/engine/technology detail entries.
